author: cdc-rfc1-author (Claude Sonnet 5.5)
rationale: gclk_b = clk_b & en_b_q with a posedge-clk_b enable flop and no low-phase latch, so the enable can change while clk_b is high: CDC-045(a) WARNING Heuristic. CDC-020 is exempt (Same domain). Reader A's missing gated-clock declaration note does not change the label.

author_reading.rationale: clk_b is gated by an AND with a posedge-launched enable register and no low-phase enable latch.

labels.rationale: The same-domain enable flop updates after a rising clock edge during the gate's sensitive high phase. The raw AND can truncate a high pulse or delay its rising edge.
labels.suspected_flaw: The gated clock has no matching declaration or reviewed relation to clk_b.

labels.rationale: Clock gclk_b is gated combinationally by assign gclk_b = clk_b & en_b_q (design.sv:14) where enable en_b_q is a posedge clk_b flip-flop (design.sv:12) without a transparent-low enable latch, allowing transitions on en_b_q while clk_b is high to glitch gclk_b (CDC-045 WARNING Heuristic).

settlement.rationale: gclk_b = clk_b & en_b_q with a posedge-clk_b enable flop and no low-phase latch, so the enable can change while clk_b is high: CDC-045(a) WARNING Heuristic. CDC-020 is exempt (Same domain). Reader A's missing gated-clock declaration note does not change the label.
